items.html:
One concrete regression in the initial patch: singular l=40, k=1e-4, r=1 gets an artificial ~1e383 radial intermediate despite finite Bessel values and physical derivatives. Your planned position-only scale for singular waves addresses it; the separate low-kr regression at moderate length scales is appropriate.

Otherwise:

  • Scale invariance and both derivative chain factors are correct; differentiating the chosen scale is unnecessary.
  • Including wavenumber in the solid-harmonic key is correct, but makes that cache redundant with the spherical-parts cache. Remove it.
  • New upstream-reference, Maxwell, Euler, and per-input finite-difference checks provide meaningful coverage.

Source/math review only; no tests, builds, or edits.
